subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core `claws export` and derivative package contract as part of the grouped Claws RFC once the prerequisite stack and real CLI proof are complete?
rationale: This creates a public CLI and portable package identity/manifest contract while the RFC, lifecycle prerequisite, and canonical CLAW.md representation remain open.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked export contract
options.body: Approve the direction after the prerequisite lifecycle lands, inspectable round-trip proof is added, and CLAW.md compatibility is reviewed together.

options.title: Defer until the format settles
options.body: Keep the PR open but pause landing until the RFC and canonical CLAW.md representation are finalized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked export contract
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after the prerequisite lifecycle lands, inspectable round-trip proof is added, and CLAW.md compatibility is reviewed together.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible owner of the grouped package model and identity boundaries adopted by this implementation.
